rows.transcription_scope: Short excerpt; complete 21.02 operative text reviewed in the search index.
reviewed_obligations: A granting rule must have triggered; the unit must be unengaged, not Battle-shocked and have made no move in this phase.
The granting rule supplies the movement maximum; ordinary Moving restrictions apply.
The player commits a closest enemy as the target before moving.
Every model must engage that target where legally possible, otherwise minimize its distance to that target.
The endpoint cannot engage any other enemy unit.
Completing Surge prevents every subsequent move in this phase.
